content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kerala Police Department Accounts Officer
content_sections.text: Download the official notification PDF and print the attached Bio-data format. Prepare a formal application letter. Fill up the Bio-data form completely. Gather attested copies of certificates proving your educational qualifications and work experience. Scan the application letter, filled Bio-data, and attested certificate copies into digital format. Send the scanned documents by email to [email protected] on or before 12/10/2026, 5.00pm.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application letter Duly filled Bio-data form Attested copies of certificates proving qualifications Attested copies of certificates proving work experience Passport-size photograph (to be affixed on the Bio-data form)

content_sections.heading: Kerala Police Department Accounts Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates will be responsible for monitoring the financial systems of police canteens and for conducting internal audits. Appointed candidates will design internal control mechanisms for improving transparency and accountability. Candidates must be willing to travel as they have to conduct audits of accounts of police canteens throughout Kerala. The appointment is temporary for a duration of 3 years. Applications must reach the specified email address on or before the last date and time.
